title: aug-2015-sexual-offences-definitive-guideline-web.pdf — section 19
text:
SEXUAL ASSAULT
Sexual assault
Sexual Offences Act 2003 (section 3)
Triable either way
Maximum: 10 years’ custody
Offence range: Community order – 7 years’ custody
For convictions on or after 3 December 2012 (irrespective of the date of commission of the
offence), this is a specified offence for the purposes of section 226A (extended sentence for
certain violent or sexual offences) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003.

18 Sexual Offences Definitive Guideline
Effective from 1 April 2014

SEXUAL ASSAULT
